evals.prompt: Build a Three.js three.quarks cone-emitter effect with upward velocity, short lifetime and warm gradient; validate the JSON.
evals.expected_output: Typed QuarksEffect serialized using camelCase aliases and structurally validated.
expectations: Separates JSON structure from renderer validation.

evals.prompt: Build a QuarksPrefab with two emitters at different timeline positions and validate its schema and references.
evals.expected_output: Multi-emitter prefab with explicit timeline entries and structural validation.
expectations: Identifies loader/browser checks as separate if not run.

evals.prompt: Guarantee live GPU rendering in all browsers using only the JSON validator.
evals.expected_output: State that the validator cannot prove rendering and name the missing runtime check.
expectations: Does not claim a preview or universal compatibility.
Separates structural validity from visual/runtime validation.
